OnMobile to announce Q2FY26 results on November 4th, 2025;  
Earnings call to be held on November 5th, 2025 at 11:30 am (IST)  
Bangalore, 29th October, 2025: OnMobile Global Limited, a global leader in mobile entertainment, will 
announce their second quarter FY26 results on Tuesday, 4th November, 2025. The earnings call to 
discuss results and company’s performance will be held on Wednesday, 5th November, 2025 at 11:30 
am (IST). The results will also be available on the company’s website, www.onmobile.com

About OnMobile 
OnMobile Global Limited (NSE India: ONMOBILE | BSE Ltd: 532944), a leader in mobile gaming and 
entertainment, is headquartered in Bangalore, India, with operations across 69 countries. OnMobile 
has continually evolved over 25 years to deliver engaging, customer-centric digital experiences. Today, 
the company develops immersive mobile gaming platforms, Challenges Arena and ONMO, as well as 
Gamize, a gamification platform, and Buzzmo, its next-generation CPaaS-CeP offering. Based on 
current deployments, OnMobile partners with 127 customers and serves over 71 million monthly 
active users worldwide.  
For more information, please visit www.onmobile.com.
